short: Engineering 2D Multifunctional Ultrathin Bismuthene for Mult
title: Engineering 2D Multifunctional Ultrathin Bismuthene for Multiple Photonic Nanomedicine

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: 2D bismuthene has not been used in nanomedicine because engineering it with the needed structure and composition is hard. Thin bismuthene should combine NIR photothermal conversion, red-light ROS generation and X-ray attenuation for imaging-guided PTT/PDT.
states.detail: Absorbed: a1 (HYP/gap), a2 (HYP/hypothesis), a3 (DES/base_system), a4 (DES/route), a5 (PRC/treatment), a6 (PRC/synthesis). Premises: Bi puckered layers: channels 5.62 A along x (VASP), 0.71 A along y; water molecule ~3.2 A

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Free-standing lamellar nanosheets ~200 nm across and ~14 nm thick. Bismuthene is a heterojunction: hexagonal Bi nanoflakes (5-25 nm) on Bi2O3 nanosheets.

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Bismuthene is a semiconductor with an optical band gap of ~0.69 eV. Strong NIR absorption: extinction coefficient 6.4 L g-1 cm-1 at 808 nm.
states.detail: Absorbed: a10 (PRP/value), a11 (PRP/value), a12 (PRP/value), a13 (PRP/value), a15 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Thinning heavy pnictogens turns metallic Bi into a semiconductor [32]; Decay of DPBF absorbance marks singlet-oxygen generation [44]

states.title: Performance state
states.head: BNs-BSA plus 660/808 nm lasers eradicates 4T1 tumours (100% inhibition and 54-day survival), beating PTT or PDT alone

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: A freeze-thaw/NaBH4 route yields 2D bismuthene for PA/CT imaging-guided synergistic PTT/PDT with no evident toxicity

nodes.note: Text says the nanoflakes are mainly Bi; the maps do not resolve Bi-rich flakes against the oxide sheet. F2f EDS spectrum shows a strong O peak and Cu from the grid. No Bi2O3 Raman bands in bismuthene although XPS gives an oxide-rich surface (surface vs bulk sensitivity); text attributes a slight blue shift to thinning.

nodes.title: ASSAY:stain, ASSAY:survival, ASSAY:tumour, F5
nodes.head: Individual curves: all five BNs-BSA+Lasers tumours stay at 0; four of five BNs-BSA+808 nm tumours regrow after ~day 14. Day-22 tumour volume ranks BNs-BSA ~ PBS (~2100-2350) > Lasers (~1750) > +660 nm (~1470) > +808 nm (~370) > +660/808 nm (0).
nodes.solves: BNs-BSA plus 660/808 nm lasers eradicates 4T1 tumours (100% inhibition and 54-day survival), beating PTT or PDT alone
nodes.note: F5h dissected tumour weights give the same ranking (combination ~0 g). Y axis reads "Morbility free survival", not survival as the caption says. Text claims maximal apoptosis and lowest proliferation in the combination group; the TUNEL/Ki-67 images do not show it. A tumour section exists for the combination group although its tumours read 0 g in F5h.
